verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents notifications (desktop, Slack, email or webhook) that fire when a Droid finishes a task or needs input. Real-time mission monitoring (factory-docs-28) and CLI approvals (factory-docs-15) mean the developer has to watch the session, so they don't deliver alerting. Slack and other integrations are described only as keeping work synchronized, not as sending completion or input-needed alerts.
